corrected_paraphrase: Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 of 14 June 2023 on machinery, repealing Directive 2006/42/EC and Directive 73/361/EEC, published OJ L 165, 29.6.2023, in force 19 Jul 2023; the application date, corrigendum and any 2026 amending act were not visible in retrieved text.
evidence_note: Retrieved title, adoption date, OJ L 165 reference and entry into force date; Art. 54, corrigendum and Reg 2026/1744 not seen.
Art. 10(1) requires design and construction per the essential health and safety requirements before placing on the market; application date not seen.
Art. 10(2) requires Annex IV Part A documentation, conformity assessment, then EU declaration and CE marking.
Art. 10(3) sets at least 10 years retention and source code on reasoned request.
Art. 3(16) and Art. 18(1)-(3) seen; the words physical or digital in 3(16) were not visible in the extraction.
Art. 20(1) gives presumption of conformity for harmonised standards published in the OJ.
Art. 20(3) allows common specifications if standardisation fails or is delayed; 20(6) gives presumption.
Art. 20(9) presumes compliance with sections 1.1.9 and 1.2.1 for cybersecurity certified machinery, insofar as covered.
Art. 21(1)-(4) seen: Annex V Part A model, updated, translated, single declaration, manufacturer responsibility.
Art. 25(2) requires module B+C, H or G for Annex I Part A.
Art. 25(3) allows module A for Part B only with harmonised standards applied; otherwise B+C, H or G.
Art. 25(4) requires module A for machinery not listed in Annex I.
Art. 6(7) opening text: Part A requires serious inherent risk plus one or more of four conditions; Part B sentence not seen.
Recital 54 on self-evolving safety systems and third party assessment, and Recital 55 on fully or partially self-evolving behaviour, seen; recitals are not operative provisions.

corrected_paraphrase: Recitals 54 and 55 say self-evolving safety function systems belong in Annex I with third party assessment, and that the software provisions only apply to systems with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour; recitals are non-operative. Art. 3(3) was not seen to support this.
evidence_note: Recital quotes seen; Art. 3(3) not seen as supporting them; application date not retrieved.
